findings.location: items/prop-dual-elimination-of-top-index-handles.md:55, Proof step 1.1, sentence beginning “Every handle body of this presentation”
findings.evidence: The sentence claims that every handle presentation has the same handle-body subsets of W. Introducing a cancelling pair changes these bodies while preserving W. Duality identifies bodies only between a fixed presentation and its reversed dual. Delete the universal assertion or restrict it to that fixed pair.
